mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM material_week_assignments a JOIN material_links l ON l.material_id = a.material_id AND l.course_id = a.course_id AND l.user_id = a.user_id JOIN course_materials cm ON cm.material_id = a.material_id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY a.material_id, a.week_no

SELECT l.link_id FROM material_links l JOIN course_materials cm ON cm.material_id = l.material_id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.course_id = #{courseId} AND l.material_id = #{materialId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM material_week_assignments WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND material_id = #{materialId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_week_assignments (user_id, course_id, material_id, placement, week_no, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{materialId}, #{placement}, #{weekNo}, #{source})
